news.title: Infantino says he is backed by 'vast majority'
news.description: Fifa president Gianni Infantino laughs off questions about whether he considered resigning over the World Cup sell-off debacle.

news.title: Jackson stars with two goals - player ratings for Aston Villa v Man City
news.description: How Aston Villa and Man City players rated following their Premier League match.

news.title: Kompany recovery will take 'weeks' as tests continue
news.description: Vincent Kompany remains stable in hospital as doctors run tests following his collapse on Friday, says Bayern Munich director Max Eberl.

news.title: 'Best team in the Championship' - Boro lay down marker
news.description: Middlesbrough thrash Bolton 5-1 to go top of the Championship and confirm their place among the promotion favourites.

news.title: Carrick refuses to rule out dropping Fernandes in emotional address
news.description: Michael Carrick speaks for five uninterrupted minutes at media briefing to outline what Manchester United means to him, then refuses to rule out dropping Bruno Fernandes.

news.title: Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes
news.description: Test your football knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

news.title: Latte Lath's journey from street games and Carrick to new start in Germany
news.description: Emmanuel Latte Lath's journey took him from Ivory Coast to Italy as a child, now he is making another new start in Germany.

news.title: Sutton's predictions v Waffle the Wonder Dog and his owner Simon
news.description: BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on Waffle the Wonder Dog and his owner Simon, plus the BBC readers and AI with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures.

news.title: Arsenal fightback to beat Tottenham as win eases pressure on Slegers
news.description: Alessia Russo scores a controversial penalty as Arsenal come from behind to beat local rivals Tottenham Hotspur 2-1 to secure just their second win of the season in the Women's Super League, and ease the pressure on manager Renee Slegers.

news.title: Forest left frustrated as winless run goes on after draw at Ipswich
news.description: Nottingham Forest ended a run of three successive league defeats but endured another night of missed chances as they drew 1-1 at Ipswich Town in the Premier League, but the result does move the away side out of the relegation zone on goal difference.
